input_schema.prompt_type: enum [opinion, discussion, adv_disadv, cause_solution, cause_effect, two_part]

core_philosophy.prevent_hallucination: Utilize multi-agent verification layers to cross-check extracted arguments against factual text segments
core_philosophy.progressive_disclosure: Do not suggest C1_C2 vocabulary if grammar_error_rate exceeds threshold
core_philosophy.no_overwriting: Highlight errors only; do not generate full rewritten paragraphs. Rewrite examples limited to single-sentence level.
core_philosophy.band_rounding_rule: Overall = average(TR, CC, LR, GRA); round to nearest 0.5 per official IELTS rounding table

scoring_formula.description: Official IELTS band score calculation for Writing Task 2

step_2_rounding.rule: Round to nearest 0.5 using IELTS official table

band_descriptors.band_9: Fully addresses all parts of the task. Position is clear throughout. Ideas are fully extended and well supported.
band_descriptors.band_8: Sufficiently addresses all parts of the task. Position is clear. Ideas are well developed with relevant support.
band_descriptors.band_7: Addresses all parts of the task, though some parts may be more fully covered. Position is clear throughout. Ideas are supported.
band_descriptors.band_6: Addresses the task only partially. Position is present but not always clear. Ideas are relevant but may lack development.
band_descriptors.band_5: The format may be inappropriate. Only partially addresses the task. Position may be unclear. Ideas are limited or repetitive.
band_descriptors.band_4: Barely addresses the task. Format may be completely inappropriate. Ideas are barely developed.

argument_parsing_PEEL.description: Extract Point, Evidence, Explanation, Link for each body paragraph

off_topic_check.description: Semantic similarity between essay and prompt topic

opinion.description: To what extent do you agree or disagree? / Do you agree or disagree?
opinion.logic_check: Compare stance in introduction vs conclusion; verify body paragraphs all support the declared stance

discussion.description: Discuss both views and give your own opinion
discussion.structure_check: Both views must be discussed BEFORE author gives personal opinion
discussion.logic_check: Verify objective analysis of both views before giving opinion; author opinion must be distinct from either view or clearly align with one

trigger_keywords: what are the advantages and disadvantages
discuss_only_variant.note: Verdict optional but absence should not penalize

balance_check.description: Check rough balance between advantages and disadvantages coverage

cause_solution.description: What are the causes? What are the solutions?
cause_solution.logic_check: Calculate semantic_similarity between cause_i and solution_i; each solution should logically address at least one stated cause

cause_effect.description: What are the causes? What are the effects/problems?
cause_effect.distinction_from_cause_solution: Effects describe consequences; solutions describe remedies. Mixing these is a TR error.
cause_effect.logic_check: Verify effects are consequences of the stated causes, not generic facts

two_part.description: Two direct questions requiring two separate answers
two_part.logic_check: Check body_1 maps to question_1 AND body_2 maps to question_2; both answers must be substantive (not one-sentence)

penalty_imbalance.note: Both questions should receive roughly equal development

band_descriptors.band_9: Uses cohesion in such a way that it attracts no attention. Skillfully manages paragraphing. Logical sequencing throughout.
band_descriptors.band_8: Sequences information and ideas logically. Manages all aspects of cohesion well. Uses paragraphing sufficiently and appropriately.
band_descriptors.band_7: Logically organises information and ideas. Uses a range of cohesive devices flexibly. May over-use or under-use some devices.
band_descriptors.band_6: Arranges information coherently. Uses some cohesive devices effectively but may be faulty or mechanical.
band_descriptors.band_5: Some organisation is evident but may not progress logically. Limited range of cohesive devices; may be repetitive.
band_descriptors.band_4: Information and ideas are not arranged coherently. Cohesive devices are largely absent or used inaccurately.

paragraph_unity_check.description: Each paragraph must contain exactly one central idea (topic sentence)

topic_sentence_check.description: Each body paragraph should begin with a clear topic sentence

logical_flow.description: Evaluate whether ideas progress logically within and between paragraphs
logical_flow.general_to_specific_check: Verify topic sentence → supporting details order

inter_paragraph_transition.description: Ideas should connect naturally across paragraphs

transition_variety_check.description: Check if the same connector is repeated excessively

invisible_cohesion.description: Ability to resolve pronouns (this, that, these, it) to preceding nouns

substitution_check.description: Use of synonyms and lexical substitution to avoid word repetition

band_descriptors.band_9: Uses a wide range of vocabulary with very natural and sophisticated control. Rare errors occur only as slips.
band_descriptors.band_8: Uses a wide range of vocabulary fluently and flexibly. Skilfully uses uncommon lexical items. Rare errors in spelling or word formation.
band_descriptors.band_7: Uses a sufficient range of vocabulary to allow flexibility and precision. Uses some less common items. Some errors in word choice or collocation.
band_descriptors.band_6: Uses an adequate range of vocabulary for the task. Attempts to use less common vocabulary but with some inaccuracy. Errors in spelling/word formation do not impede communication.
band_descriptors.band_5: Uses a limited range of vocabulary. Repetitive use of words. Errors in spelling/word formation are noticeable.
band_descriptors.band_4: Basic vocabulary only. Errors are frequent and may distort meaning.

cefr_profiling.guard: Do not flag C1_C2 suggestions if grammar_error_rate > 0.30

examples_of_common_errors: make a research → conduct a research / do research
a strong opinion → a firm opinion

paraphrasing_check.description: Introduction should paraphrase the prompt, not copy it
paraphrasing_check.note: Distinguish from intentional keyword repetition which is acceptable

word_form_errors.description: Check incorrect use of word forms (noun/verb/adjective/adverb substitution)

idiom_fixed_expression_check.description: Detect use of natural idiomatic expressions vs awkward literal translations

vocabulary_repetition.description: Flag over-reliance on a small set of high-frequency words

band_descriptors.band_9: Uses a wide range of structures with full flexibility and accuracy. Rare errors occur only as slips.
band_descriptors.band_8: Uses a wide range of structures. Majority of sentences are error-free. Occasional non-systematic errors.
band_descriptors.band_7: Uses a variety of complex structures. Produces frequent error-free sentences. Some errors persist but do not impede communication.
band_descriptors.band_6: Uses a mix of simple and complex sentence forms. Makes some errors in grammar and punctuation. Errors rarely impede communication.
band_descriptors.band_5: Uses only a limited range of structures. Attempts complex sentences but errors are frequent. May impede communication.
band_descriptors.band_4: Uses only a very limited range of structures. Subordinate clauses are rare. Errors are frequent and distort meaning.

syntactic_complexity.definition: complex_sentence = clause_nodes >= 2 (subordinate, relative, or adverbial clause present)

structure_variety.description: Evaluate presence of diverse grammatical structures

passive_voice_check.description: Passive voice should be used contextually (e.g., when agent is unknown or unimportant)

gerund_infinitive_check.description: Verb patterns requiring gerund or infinitive
gerund_infinitive_check.condition: wrong_verb_pattern_used (e.g., enjoy to do → enjoy doing)

band_level_analysis.TR_band_evidence: string (what evidence supports the TR band awarded)
